absorptionFactors.description: FDA explains that dietary fat helps absorption of vitamins A, D, E and K. This does not supply a personal fat dose or an absorption percentage.

deficiency.overview: The source explains physiological roles of fat; it does not provide diagnostic criteria for inadequate fat intake from a food log.
deficiency.medicalBoundary: Symptoms are nonspecific and cannot diagnose a nutrient deficiency. Diagnosis may require clinical evaluation and appropriate laboratory testing.

excess.overview: This label-education source is not an individual fat-intake ceiling or clinical risk assessment.
